home.heroTitle: Is your website accessible to everyone?
home.heroSubtitle: A free website accessibility checker for NGOs and government. Enter your web address and get a clear, plain-language report of what to fix. No expertise needed. Free forever.
home.differenceBody: Most tools only run automated checks and mark the rest "needs review". We go further. Automated scanning finds the clear issues. AI-assisted review helps with the rest. And independent human review by people with lived experience of disability — launching soon — will confirm what machines cannot, producing a signed, evidence-based report, not just a list of errors.
home.step1Body: Paste the URL of the page or site you want to check.
home.step2Body: Our engine checks your pages against WCAG, the web accessibility standard.
home.step3Body: A plain-language report of what to fix first, and how to fix it.
home.sampleNote: An example report. Yours shows a score, the top issues to fix first, and how each was tested — machine, AI, or human review.
home.sampleIssue2: Text colour contrast is too low
home.persona1Body: Meet WCAG AA requirements with independent evidence — not just a self-declared statement.
home.persona2Body: Reach every person you serve — including people with disabilities.
home.persona3Body: Get verifiable accessibility evidence for due diligence.
home.persona4Body: Prioritised findings with a suggested fix, evidence, and how each was tested.
home.outcome1Body: WCAG 2.0, 2.1, 2.2 (A/AA/AAA) and Section 508, mapped to EN 301 549 and regional regulations.
home.outcome2Body: Every finding carries the affected element, page, and WCAG reference — an auditable record.
home.outcome3Body: Paid reviewers with lived experience of disability resolve what automation cannot.
home.outcome4Title: A report you can act on
home.outcome4Body: Signed, dated, and ranked by what to fix first — with a suggested fix for each issue.
home.trustPoint1: Independent human review is coming soon — we are building a review workforce with charities that serve people with visual and hearing disabilities.
home.trustPoint2: Free forever — funded by donations, not by charging for scans.
home.trustPoint3: We hold ourselves to the same standard — this site targets WCAG 2.2 AAA.
home.trustPoint4: Open about how it works — read our methodology and how we validate the engine.
home.founderBody1: Simon Mak is an entrepreneur, author, and sustainability advocate — and he lives with Parkinson's disease. He founded Ascent Partners Foundation because accessibility is not an abstract cause to him; it is personal. That is why this tool is built by people with lived experience of disability — from our founder to the review workforce we are building with disability-serving charities — for everyone who is too often excluded from the web.
home.founderBody2: His work connects finance and sustainability — and digital accessibility is the "social" in ESG.
home.founderEsgLink: See how the report maps to GRI, ESRS, and SASB
